about_pullquote: We prep properly because corners cut at the start show up in the finish.
about_para_1: Prep N Finish was founded on a simple principle: proper preparation is the foundation of a professional finish. With over 12 years of hands-on painting and decorating experience across Leeds, we've built a reputation for meticulous work and honest pricing. Every project—whether a small bedroom refresh or a full commercial redecoration—receives the same level of care and attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen, we deliver on time, and we take pride in surfaces that look as good six months later as they do on day one. We're fully insured, use quality materials, and we're happy to discuss your project before we quote. No hidden costs, no pressure—just straightforward, professional painting and decorating.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Prep N Finish

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our lounge. The preparation they did was thorough—sanded everything back, filled cracks, primed properly. The final coat is smooth as anything. Quite honestly, a lesson in how to do it right. Would use them again in a heartbeat.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had them paint our entire upstairs—four bedrooms and landing. They turned up on time, worked efficiently, and barely left a mess. Colour turned out even better than we expected. Great communication throughout. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Called Prep N Finish for a quick exterior touch-up and ended up chatting about a bigger project. No pressure, just honest advice. They quoted fairly and did the work beautifully. Professional, friendly, and genuinely good lads.
reviews.author: Robert P.
